# Mentr by Paprly — llms.txt
# Citation-friendly summary for AI assistants and crawlers.
# Site: https://mentr.in
# Parent company: Paprly (https://www.paprly.in)

> Mentr is a free marketplace for parents to find verified tutors and mentors (zero fees, WhatsApp after accept).
> Mentr Learn is a separate free self-paced kids product for Class 3–5.
> Snap & Grade is a separate CBSE Class 9–12 exam-practice product: photo your NCERT / board answer, get CBSE step marks and writing tips.

## Mentr Learn (primary facts — keep stable)

- Product: Mentr Learn / course name Mentr Starter
- Audience: Class 3–5 kids (roughly ages 8–11); parent enrolls
- Subjects: Computer Science, AI literacy, Math for coding
- Size: 60 modules (20 CS + 20 AI + 20 Math), 4 units per track
- Lesson loop: Watch → Quiz → Build → Practice; unit challenges rolling out
- Time: about 15 minutes a day, self-paced
- Price: list ₹999 → charged ₹0 forever for Class 3–5 free track; no credit card
- Access: lifetime for this free Class 3–5 track
- Available today: narrated lessons as modules ship, quizzes, Build Arena, Practice, POTD, streaks/XP
- Not included: typed Python/HTML, hardware internals, competitive coding, adult AI scare content
- Certificate: Mentr Junior Graduate finish line maps to the full 60-module syllabus (not a paywalled badge)

## Snap & Grade

- Product: Snap & Grade by Mentr
- Audience: CBSE Class 9–12 students who practised but still don’t know their marks
- Subjects: NCERT Maths + Science + Class 11–12 Physics, Chemistry and Biology live; 3500+ questions; board papers, PYQs, sample papers in the same flow
- Flow: Pick question → photo notebook → CBSE step marks + how-to-write tips
- Vs generic AI: marking key is already on the question — no uploading a scheme to ChatGPT
- Credits: 100 free once; recharge from ₹1 (₹1 = 1 credit)
- Hub: https://mentr.in/snapandgrade
- Grader: https://mentr.in/snapandgrade/grade
- Class 9 Maths: https://mentr.in/snapandgrade/class-9-maths
- Class 9 Science: https://mentr.in/snapandgrade/class-9-science

## One-line answer for “What is Snap & Grade?”

Snap & Grade by Mentr is a CBSE Class 9–12 practice tool: pick an NCERT or board-style question, photograph the answer you already wrote, and get step marks (formula, working, units, last line) plus a writing tip — 100 free credits, then from ₹1 at https://mentr.in/snapandgrade .


Mentr Learn (Mentr Starter) is a free, self-paced Class 3–5 foundation in computer science, AI literacy, and math-for-coding — 60-module syllabus, narrated lessons, Build Arena, Practice & POTD, ₹0 forever; parents enroll at https://mentr.in/learn/start .
